items.author: @ratlimit
items.text:
I saw a profile pic featuring the most strangely beautiful woman I’ve ever seen.

Yup, in my notifications.

But the Likes kept flowing. A river of notifications. Before I could click her, she was swept away. To whom did I owe the pleasure?

Internet, do your thing! 🙏

coverage: Seven posts, November 2026. Compiled Saturday, Nov. 14, ET.
